verdict.rationale: Pigment's own docs say the Analyst Agent 'continuously monitors your business', which is background, autonomous agent activity. They also mention scheduled imports, a recurring data-integration automation, but only in a single phrase. There is no documentation that users can define their own background automations, set triggers or recurring agent schedules, or have actions run unattended. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation/workflow builder, recurring schedules or triggers for agent tasks, details of unattended execution and outputs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: The Analyst Agent continuously monitors your business, uncovers what matters and builds reports from simple conversations
easily integrated through native connectors, open APIs, and scheduled imports.
